candidates.headline: 15% off Slim Jeans – Perfect for New Customers
candidates.rationale: New shoppers are likely to buy complementary apparel; a 15% discount encourages bulk purchase without exceeding margin constraints.

candidates.headline: ₹200 Off Any Order – Welcome Gift
candidates.rationale: Offering a ₹200 flat discount lowers the entry barrier for new customers, aligning with the Rs 500–2000 at-risk band.

candidates.headline: Classic Tee + Cap Bundle – 15% Off
candidates.rationale: Bundling a top‑selling tee with a cap taps cross‑sell affinity, delivering value while staying within 20% discount caps.

candidates.headline: Earn ₹150 Loyalty Credit on Your First Purchase
candidates.rationale: A ₹150 loyalty credit encourages repeat buying, fitting new shoppers into the brand’s loyalty funnel.

candidates.headline: Your Cart Awaits – Complete Your Purchase
candidates.rationale: A cost‑free reminder nudges new shoppers to finalize their first order, capitalizing on cross‑sell potential.

candidates.headline: 12% Off Hoodie – Ideal for New Customers
candidates.rationale: A modest 12% discount on a popular hoodie encourages new shoppers to try higher‑margin apparel without breaching discount limits.

candidates.headline: ₹350 Off Any Order – First‑Time Special
candidates.rationale: A ₹350 flat discount falls within the at‑risk band and boosts conversion for new customers.

candidates.headline: Hoodie + Backpack Bundle – 15% Off
candidates.rationale: Pairing a hoodie with a backpack targets complementary purchases, maximizing cross‑sell while staying under discount caps.
